mapper.select: SELECT id, name, host, port, password, db, remark, create_time, update_time FROM redis_datasource WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redis_datasource (name, host, port, password, db, remark, uid) VALUES (#{name}, #{host}, #{port}, #{password}, #{db}, #{remark}, #{uid})
mapper.update: UPDATE redis_datasource SET name=#{name}, host=#{host}, port=#{port}, password=#{password}, db=#{db}, remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id}
